za.ac.aop.api

Class CallInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • za.ac.aop.api.CallInfo

  • public class CallInfo
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents call information.

    Example record:

     05/11/2023    07:35:16    07:35:50    221    0824489195    Vodacom
    • callDate - Date on which the call occurred.
    • startTime - Time when the call started.
    • endTime - Time when the call ended.
    • extension - Call Extension of a consultant/employee.
    • phoneNumber - Mobile number associated with the call.
    • networkProvider - Telecommunications service provider.
